title: Don't Make Me Click
summary: A Google Tech Talk arguing that the best interface requires the fewest clicks and choices, with Google search, Facebook, the iPod and Firefox as examples. It shows how minimizing interaction makes interfaces easier to learn.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a companion to Steve Krug's usability advice and as a talk on minimal interface design.

quote.text: Read Don't Make Me Think! by Steve Krug. Also watch this talk titled
